execute:

  echo: false

```{r setup, cache = FALSE, message = FALSE}
root <- "../.."
devtools::load_all(file.path(root, "package/pitchinj"))
source(file.path(root, "scripts/functions/figures.R"))
source(file.path(root, "scripts/functions/tables.R"))

output_dir <- file.path(root, "output")
```

```{dot fig-consort}
digraph {
  node [shape = box, height = 1.1, width = 3]
  A [label = "All MLB and MiLB pitcher-seasons\nlevel A+ and above, 2018-2026\nN = 19,084"]
  B [
    label = "Excluded MiLB 2018-2021\nbecause MiLB pitch tracking\nstarted in 2021\nN = 4,910",
    style = "filled"
  ]
  C [label = "MLB 2018-2026 pitcher-seasons\nand MiLB 2022-2026 pitcher-seasons\nN = 14,174"]
  D [
    label = "Excluded pitcher-seasons\nwith insufficient prior-year\npitch-tracking data\nN = 2,220",
    style = "filled"
  ]
  E [label = "Full cohort for primary analysis\nN = 11,954"]
  A -> C -> E
  A -> B
  C -> D
}
```

## Results

```{r fig-pitch-reclass}
#| fig-asp: 1.5
#| layout-ncol: 2
pitch_reclass <- data.table::fread(file.path(output_dir, "models/pitch_reclass.csv"))
fig_pitch_class_old(pitch_reclass)
fig_pitch_class_new(pitch_reclass)
```

```{r tab-multivariate-hits-full}
coxph_multivariate_hits_full <- readRDS(
  file.path(output_dir, "models/coxph_multivariate_hits_full.rds")
)
tab_multivariate(coxph_multivariate_hits_full)
```

```{r tab-univariate}
coxph_univariate <- readRDS(file.path(output_dir, "models/coxph_univariate.rds"))
tab_univariate(coxph_univariate)
```

```{r fig-prob-injury-density}
pred_injury <- data.table::fread(file.path(output_dir, "models/pred_injury.csv"))
fig_prob_injury_density(pred_injury)
```
